title: Jumbo Canadian Oreo Cream Biscuits Pudding
description: A rich and dense dessert featuring crushed oreo cream biscuits, perfect for a cozy monsoon evening.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the milk, sugar, cornstarch, and salt. Cook over medium heat, whisking constantly.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 2 minutes.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and let it cool slightly.
Stir in the melted butter and vanilla extract, if using.
Let the pudding cool to room temperature, then cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
Just before serving, top the pudding with the crushed Oreo cream biscuits.
If desired, garnish with additional crushed biscuits or whipped cream.
Note: You can also make this pudding in individual cups or ramekins for a fun presentation.
